title: Compute heterogeneous nucleation work reduction
action: Using the wetting angles θ=94° for uncoated Al2O3 and θ=45° for Ni-coated Al2O3, and the heterogeneous nucleation work ratio formula ΔG'_K/ΔG_K = (2 - 3 cos θ + cos³ θ) / 4, compute the nucleation work ratios for both cases and the percentage reduction. Write the results to nucleation_work_results.json.
description: Calculate nucleation work ratios and reduction percentage from given wetting angles and formula.
